## Exact carry repairs required by the shorter ring

The first literal integration exposed two distinct failures which are retained in the local research record.

First, a full Cuccaro MAJ observation at a truncated source edge includes the next source bit. The wider parent supplied a zero at this edge; the shorter ring can expose a live foreign bit. The conservative production repair preserves the next-source witness under the appropriate guard in the existing HR sv or HT g scratch location, excludes that witness from helper banks, applies the correction at the observation point, restores the source and then erases the witness. A cheaper HT alternative was explored but is not the active implementation.

Second, simply truncating the stage5 payload update one bit earlier drops an incoming carry. That left scratch dirty at a later measured erasure and produced a phase failure. Let G=2^min(floor(log2(k+1)),4), with active k from0 through22. The inherited coarse source boundary is b=258-G*floor(sy/G)-k. On the declared active support, sz+1+(sy mod G)<=b<=258-sy. Source data below b may contribute normally. At b the candidate must include the incoming carry while excluding the first foreign source bit. The restored Cuccaro down cell provides exactly this carry without another quantum owner. The resulting payload limit is H=259-G*floor(sy/G), not the earlier rejected258-based mask.
